description: Stories that are new, got a new development, or got a stronger status or a first original source since a time, optionally only for a watchlist of organisations, products, models or packages, and only some kinds of change. Pass the checked_at from the previous reply as since next time, to see each change once. Oldest first; when more is true, call again with that checked_at as since for the rest.

change_types.description: Only these kinds of change, such as breaking_change and security. Stories not classified yet are included too (change_type null), so a story classified after your check isn't missed.

items.description: What kind of change: capability (New capability), breaking_change (Breaking change), outage (Outage), pricing_and_limits (Pricing and limits), security (Security), regulation (Rules and regulation), business (Business), research (Research), other (Other)

companies.description: Only stories about any of these organisations, or applying to these products, models or packages, such as OpenAI, gemini-embedding-2 or vllm.

since.description: The checked_at of the previous reply, or an ISO 8601 time such as 2026-11-06T09:00:00Z.

name: changes_since
title: What changed since my last check
